steps.clue: Survive the Generators lockdown and repair the Nova-6 ventilation units.
Activate Rushmore, use the Galvaknuckles on the television and set the six house clocks.
Guide the red Nova-6 Crawler into the Transfusion Facility.
Activate the A.D.A.M. robot by entering the codes into Rushmore.
Use the A.D.A.M. robot to obtain Marlton’s Element 115 canister.
Use a Jolting Jack to free the Power Core and deliver it to Operations.
Use Brain Rot to reveal the three painting codes and enter them into Rushmore.
Set the six bunker switches and restore power at the Power House.
Complete the three A.D.A.M. mannequin lockdowns and rebuild the unit in APD Interrogation.
Escort the Elemental Orb into the repaired A.D.A.M. Unit.
Release the Avogadro and charge the four backup soul canisters.
Force the Avogadro back into the A.P.D. and recover the Elemental Shard.
